config.script:
docId=self.view.custom.loadPath.id
	connector=self.view.custom.loadPath.connector
	collection=self.view.custom.loadPath.collection
	filename=self.view.custom.loadPath.filename
	from system.mongodb.types import ObjectId
	filter = {"_id":ObjectId(docId)}
	doc=system.mongodb.findOne(connector, collection, filter)
	
	del doc['_id']
	
	#copy to other mongoDB Collection
	newConnector=self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value
	newCollection=self.getSibling("Dropdown_0").props.value
	system.mongodb.insertOne(newConnector, newCollection, doc)
	# Specify unique field values to locate specific document. Here we are specifying the known _id of the document.
	  
	#Delete mongo data from collection
	system.mongodb.deleteOne(connector, collection, filter)

	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").refreshBinding("props.items")
	
	message='"{}" Successfully Moved From "{}:{}" To "{}:{}"'.format(filename, connector, collection, newConnector, newCollection)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 5, "color": "--success"}, scope="session")

newFilename=self.getSibling("TextField").props.text
	oldFilename=self.view.custom.loadPath.filename
	docID=self.view.custom.loadPath.id
	connector=self.view.custom.loadPath.connector
	collection=self.view.custom.loadPath.collection
	
	from system.mongodb.types import ObjectId
	 
	# Specify unique field values to locate specific document. Here we are specifying the known _id of the document.
	filter = {"_id": ObjectId(docID)}
	 
	# Specify document fields to update for found BSON document(s). 'accounts' is an existing field on the document.
	updates = [
	            {"$set":
	                {
	                    "filename": newFilename
	                }
	            }
	        ]
	   
	# Apply parameters for function call.
	system.mongodb.updateOne(connector, collection, filter, updates)
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").refreshBinding('props.items')
	message='"{}"\n Successfully Renamed To\n"{}"'.format(oldFilename, newFilename)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 3, "color": "--success"}, scope="session")

from system.mongodb.types import ObjectId
	filename=self.view.custom.loadPath.filename
	connector=self.view.custom.loadPath.connector
	collection=self.view.custom.loadPath.collection
	# Specify unique field values to locate specific document. Here we are specifying the known _id of the document.
	filter = {"_id": ObjectId(self.view.custom.loadPath.id)}
	   
	# Apply parameters for function call.
	system.mongodb.deleteOne(connector, collection, filter)
	self.getSibling("Tree").refreshBinding("props.items")
	self.getSibling("Tree").props.selection=[]
	self.getSibling("Tree").props.selectionData=[]
	self.props.value=0
	message='"{}" Deleted Successfully'.format(filename)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("Toast", {"message": message, "delay": 3, "color": "--success", "textColor": "Black"}, scope="session")
